decisions.reason: As a close, certified extension of the established heat-exchanger portfolio, it is likely cheap to keep available and still has option value despite weak recent visibility.
Earlier evidence of strong market acceptance and its clear fit with the marine cooling franchise make withdrawal unlikely even if the website no longer highlights it separately.
After several years without clear positive signals, this narrower marine offering appears less likely to earn further commitment than competing uses of engineering and development resources.
The compact oil cooler remains adjacent to core capabilities and is probably not very costly to retain, though the lack of recent visibility means it faces a meaningful pruning risk.
